accounts_credit_limit_valid.name: accounts_credit_limit_valid
accounts_credit_limit_valid.value:
(("accounts"."type")::text = 'credit_card') = ("accounts"."credit_limit" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("accounts"."credit_limit" IS NULL OR "accounts"."credit_limit" > 0)

debt_entries_payment_shape.name: debt_entries_payment_shape
debt_entries_payment_shape.value:
"debt_entries"."kind" <> 'payment' OR ("debt_entries"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "debt_entries"."principal_part" >= 0 AND "debt_entries"."interest_part" >= 0
        AND "debt_entries"."principal_part" + "debt_entries"."interest_part" = "debt_entries"."amount")

debts_default_account_differs.name: debts_default_account_differs
debts_default_account_differs.value: "debts"."default_account_id" IS NULL OR "debts"."default_account_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "debts"."account_id"

goals_savings_shape.name: goals_savings_shape
goals_savings_shape.value: ("goals"."kind" = 'savings') = ("goals"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "goals"."target_amount" IS NOT NULL)

goals_savings_only_fields.name: goals_savings_only_fields
goals_savings_only_fields.value: "goals"."kind" <> 'savings' OR ("goals"."start_balance" IS NULL AND "goals"."extra_payment" IS NULL AND "goals"."strategy" IS NULL)

goals_debt_payoff_shape.name: goals_debt_payoff_shape
goals_debt_payoff_shape.value:
"goals"."kind" <> 'debt_payoff' OR ("goals"."target_date" IS NOT NULL AND "goals"."start_balance" IS NOT NULL
        AND "goals"."extra_payment" IS NOT NULL AND "goals"."strategy" IS NOT NULL AND "goals"."monthly_contribution" IS NULL)

income_sources_rule_complete.name: income_sources_rule_complete
income_sources_rule_complete.value:
("income_sources"."frequency" = 'monthly' AND "income_sources"."day_of_month" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("income_sources"."frequency" = 'every_n_months' AND "income_sources"."day_of_month" IS NOT NULL AND "income_sources"."interval_months" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("income_sources"."frequency" IN ('weekly', 'biweekly') AND "income_sources"."day_of_week" IS NOT NULL)

menu_day_template_items_kind.name: menu_day_template_items_kind
menu_day_template_items_kind.value: ("menu_day_template_items"."dish_id" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_day_template_items"."servings" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_day_template_items"."product_id" IS NULL AND "menu_day_template_items"."quantity_milli" IS NULL) OR ("menu_day_template_items"."dish_id" IS NULL AND "menu_day_template_items"."servings" IS NULL AND "menu_day_template_items"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_day_template_items"."quantity_milli" IS NOT NULL)

menu_entries_kind.name: menu_entries_kind
menu_entries_kind.value: ("menu_entries"."dish_id" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_entries"."servings" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_entries"."product_id" IS NULL AND "menu_entries"."quantity_milli" IS NULL) OR ("menu_entries"."dish_id" IS NULL AND "menu_entries"."servings" IS NULL AND "menu_entries"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_entries"."quantity_milli" IS NOT NULL)

transactions_transfer_shape.name: transactions_transfer_shape
transactions_transfer_shape.value:
("transactions"."type" = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."to_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."to_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id" AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "transactions"."to_account_id" IS NULL)
